hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Starting from a single element with value one, consider incrementing it to an optimal value x before duplicating it.

hints.title: Cost Decomposition
hints.text: Reaching value x requires x - 1 increments. Reaching total sum k with copies of x requires ceil(k / x) elements, needing ceil(k / x) - 1 duplicate operations.

hints.title: Total Expression
hints.text: Minimize the objective (x - 1) + (k + x - 1) // x - 1 over all candidate values of x up to k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing values of x around the square root of k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy single-step simulation without planning values leads to suboptimal step counts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using closed mathematical search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Express total operations as a function of the duplicated value x and optimize.
